restrictions: Use only 36-byte messages, defined as the first 36 bytes of the big-endian concatenation of two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words. 36 bytes pad to exactly one 64-byte block under FIPS 180-4 (36 + 1 + 19 zero bytes + BE8(288)), so the fixed standard IV is used once and rounds 0 through 30 execute exactly once per message.

The target is executed at most once per sampled message plus two verification calls. Schedule expansion for W[16..30] and all 31 round internals stay inside the single one-unit compression price and are not charged a second time.

Duplicate detection is an exact eviction-free two-level direct-address dictionary on the full 256-bit digest, split into a 128-bit prefix and a 64-bit suffix. Every distinct digest is stored exactly once and never overwritten, so if any two sampled digests are equal the second arrival meets the first at level 2. A single-level hashed table is not usable: at the load factor of this sample count it evicts about 37 percent of records and a colliding pair whose cell was overwritten in between is never detected.

Level 2 is entered only when the prefix is already claimed. At the declared sample count the level-1 path is taken with probability 0.632 and the level-2 path with 0.368, and the ledger charges those two paths at their true weights rather than charging the longest path to every sample.

No large array is initialized or cleared: every access is guarded by a flag that a previous insertion in this same run set, so no uninitialised word is ever interpreted as data. Only code, constants and workspace initialization is charged, at 2^20 charged operations.

This package contains no expected-work term, no tail bound and no timeout, and the success bound is not traded against any resource cap. Every ordinary-operation budget is a worst case on every random tape and holds for every output distribution p.

The algorithm returns a valid ordinary collision on the event that some sampled digest repeats while no sampled message repeats. If an identical message is drawn twice the pair is rejected and not counted as success; the probability of that event is bounded by the repeated-input union bound and is below 2^-33.
Total time charges all n sampled messages including every failed trial, all table accesses, and the final re-verification. There are no restarts, no rejection loop and no success amplification.

memory_log2_bytes bounds peak resident bytes and charges the whole reachable level-2 address space (one suffix block of 2^128 cells per distinct prefix) rather than only the cells actually written. Memory is a reported metric only and contributes nothing to time_log2.

nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes = 0 is a one-byte upper bound with zero actual advice. All tables are built during the run; no favorable seed, cached collision, precomputed search or omitted work is supplied.

This is an unconditional analytic construction with no experiment, no computed witness, no hidden precomputed search and no heuristic premise. It does not claim improvement over the nominal reference.
